def striptags(text: str) -> str:
    """Strip HTML tags from text without unescaping entities.

    Unlike markupsafe's implementation which uses html.unescape internally,
    this function preserves HTML entities like & as-is.
    """
    return re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', '', text)


def render_inner_html(md: Markdown, elem: etree.Element) -> str:
    """Serialize the inner HTML of an element (children only, not self)."""
    parts: list[str] = []
    for child in elem:
        parts.append(md.serializer(child))
    return ''.join(parts)


def run_postprocessors(md: Markdown, text: str) -> str:
    """Run all postprocessors on the given text."""
    result = text
    for pp in md.postprocessors:
        result = pp.run(result)
    return result
